final_message:
I wrote the deviation report (s3-deviation-report.docx). It finds the draft S-3 is not fileable: 41 deviations, 13 of them critical, and 14 more inconsistencies inside the 10-K and S-1 themselves. Much of the draft was copied from the 2021 S-1 and never updated: officers, board, financing, litigation, business and properties. The biggest question is eligibility: the draft says the 10-K was filed March 3, 2025, but it is signed and audited March 28, 2025. For a large accelerated filer that would be late, which would cost S-3/WKSI and automatic-shelf status. The file opens and passes the docx validator.
